detail.longDescription: Stoke CI is in free beta: fast CI runners for Forgejo, hosted in the EU. Every job runs in a fresh VM in Germany with warm caches for Rust and Docker. Add runs-on: stoke-2cpu to a job and push. On a small Rust CLI, clippy went from 6 min on a plain self-hosted runner (installing Rust every job) to 20 s with warm caches. Signups are approved by hand during the beta. Feedback very welcome! https:// stokeci.dev # Forgejo # Codeberg # CI # RustLang # selfhosted
